reference_sql:
WITH order_days AS (  -- one row per order
  SELECT o.order_id,
         o.store_id,
         CAST(timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone(s.timezone, o.order_ts)) AS DATE) AS true_day,
         CAST(timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', o.order_ts)) AS DATE) AS report_day
  FROM orders AS o
  JOIN stores AS s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
)
SELECT s.store_id,
       s.store_code,
       COUNT(*) AS n_orders,
       SUM(CASE WHEN d.true_day <> d.report_day THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_wrong_day
FROM order_days AS d
JOIN stores AS s ON s.store_id = d.store_id
GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_code
ORDER BY s.store_id

WITH order_days AS (  -- one row per order
  SELECT o.order_id,
         o.store_id,
         CASE WHEN o.channel = 'web'
              THEN CAST(timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', o.order_ts)) AS DATE)
              ELSE CAST(timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone(s.timezone, o.order_ts)) AS DATE)
         END AS true_day,
         CAST(timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', o.order_ts)) AS DATE) AS report_day
  FROM orders AS o
  JOIN stores AS s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
)
SELECT s.store_id,
       s.store_code,
       COUNT(*) AS n_orders,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.true_day <> d.report_day) AS n_wrong_day
FROM order_days AS d
JOIN stores AS s ON s.store_id = d.store_id
GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_code
ORDER BY s.store_id

solver.query:
SELECT s.store_id, s.store_code, COUNT(*) AS n_orders,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE CAST((o.order_ts AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Amsterdam' AS DATE)
     <> CAST((o.order_ts AT TIME ZONE (CASE WHEN o.channel = 'web' THEN 'UTC' ELSE s.timezone END)) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Amsterdam' AS DATE)) AS n_wrong_day
FROM orders o
JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_code
ORDER BY s.store_id
